question: In Head and Neck trials, from the secondary endpoint text flag if immune-related adverse events (irAEs) were explicitly assessed.

steps.desc: Filter Head and Neck trials and select secondary endpoint text.
Determine if irAEs were explicitly assessed based on secondary endpoint text.
steps.prompt: For each row, read the Secondary endpoint text and determine if immune-related adverse events (irAEs) were explicitly assessed. Output a JSON object with keys NCT, PMID, and irae_assessed. The value of irae_assessed should be either "yes", "no", or "unclear". If the text mentions irAEs, immune-related adverse events, or similar terms, then set irae_assessed to "yes". If there is no mention of irAEs or related terms, set irae_assessed to "no". If the secondary endpoint is missing or it is truly unclear whether irAEs were assessed, set irae_assessed to "unclear". Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
